title: Universal AI Chat PDF Exporter
description: Export & archive full conversations from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek & more into publication-ready, beautiful PDFs with 1 click.
longDescription: A privacy-focused, local-first Manifest V3 Chrome extension that captures and formats your AI conversations into presentation-grade PDFs, Markdown, JSON, and EPUB documents with a zero-loss completeness guarantee.
